provenance: Original synthetic LiquidBench Milestone 6 development fixture; not training or held-out data.
runtime_subset: Core Ruby Liquid with supplied hashes only; or static schema/reference contracts. No Shopify service emulation.
prompt: Repair snippets/cart-arithmetic.liquid. lines is an array of price/quantity nonnegative integers; discount is a nonnegative integer. Output p class=total containing the base-10 integer max(0, sum(price times quantity) minus discount), with no currency symbols or separators. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/cart-arithmetic.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
